author: Inside Edition
description: There was more drama today in the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts woman accused of strangling her three kids to death in 2023. Clancy's doctor took the stand at Plymouth Superior Court and was asked about her defense that she was suffering from postpartum psychosis. Clancy's mental health in the time leading up to her children's deaths has been a key topic in the trial. Inside Edition's Alison Hall has the details.
title: Lindsay Clancy's Doctor Testifies About Postpartum Psychosis

author: Inside Edition
description: Two sisters in Vernon, New Jersey discovered an unwelcome guest under their porch: a black bear. The uninvited ursine didn't seem to want to leave on its own, so the sisters began stomping on the porch to shoo it away. When that didn't work, they called police. Their stomping was also unsuccessful, so they brought out the big guns, literally. Officers fired a rubber bullet from a shotgun, and its noise scared off the bear.
title: Sisters Stomp On Porch To Try To Get Rid Of Bear

author: Inside Edition
description: Remember viral sensation Candace Payne, aka "Chewbacca Mom?" The merry, be-masked mother was an early viral sensation. Now, Inside Edition is happy to report that there is a NEW "Chewbacca Mom," and it turns out she's every bit as entertaining as her predecessor. Gabrielle Chose, from Minneapolis, Minnesota, wore a Chewbacca mask while she was in labor. It must have worked: shortly afterward, Gabrielle gave birth to her son, Kaizen.
title: Move Over, Chewbacca Mom. There's A NEW Chewbacca Mom In Town

author: Inside Edition
description: Amanda Knox is back in the news. The American one-time college exchange student was wrongfully convicted and eventually acquitted in the 2007 death of her roommate in Italy. Now Knox is telling her story in a comedy act at the renowned Edinburgh Fringe Festival in Scotland. But the family of her late roommate isn't laughing. Knox is making it clear that she will not joke specifically about her roommate's death, and will instead focus on her own experience of being falsely accused.
title: Amanda Knox Turns Her Wrongful Conviction Into A Comedy Act

author: Inside Edition
description: The man accused of trying to murder a teenager by cutting off his air supply is speaking out. Michael Joseph Simpson Jr. says the story is being reported all wrong. He claims he never touched the tube bringing air to a teen who was diving for lobsters in the waters off south Florida, near Miami. The teen was allegedly gasping for air when he came to the surface. Simpson spoke with Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano.
title: Accused Lobsterman Speaks Out

author: Inside Edition
description: Who knew a popular lunch item would become a lightning rod over the state of the nation's economy? Political commentators, particularly on the right wing, have been debating how much the beloved tortilla-encased meal should cost. Even the vice president is getting into the battle. 'Burritogate' has revealed anxieties over the cost of living, and the political cost of rising food prices. Inside Edition's Justin Finch explains.
title: The 'Burrito Wars' Are Getting Heated

author: Inside Edition
description: This isn't something most Freehold, New Jersey, residents have to worry about often. An eight-foot-long Burmese python was found in someone's backyard. And by the looks of it, the reptile had just eaten a large meal. To avoid getting captured, the snake played hide-and-seek and holed up under a shed's floorboards. A local contractor was called to take apart the structure so the snake could be caught. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Massive Burmese Python Found In New Jersey Backyard

author: Inside Edition
description: This woman really enjoys the feeling of wind in her hair. At age 97, Betty Bromage says she'll never tire of her hobby of wing walking. That's when she gets strapped to the wing of an airplane and taken for a ride around the sky as the plane does loops and other stunts. Her friends and neighbors from her retirement community watched safely from the ground, many of them in disbelief. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 97-Year-Old Woman Sets Another Record For Wing Walking

author: Inside Edition
description: The childhood home of Neil Armstrong is for sale in Wapakoneta, Ohio for $430,000. Karen Mikesell purchased the home in 1978, nearly a decade after Neil Armstrong became the first person to walk on the moon. Now, in her early 80s, it is time for her to sell the historic house and let someone else share in the history of it. Karen did everything she could to preserve it as it was when Armstrong was living there, and turned much of it into a shrine to his achievements.
title: Neil Armstrong's Childhood Home Is For Sale

author: Inside Edition
description: A man allegedly committed arson, arriving at and fleeing the scene, in a golf cart. The Kitsap County Sheriff in Washington released video of the incident. Home surveillance video shows the golf cart drive up to a garage with a man and a dog riding in it. It then shows the man using a blow torch, and a can of flammable liquid according to officials, to set fire to the structure. Then he drives off. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Arson Suspect Drove Golf Cart To And From Crime Scene
